subject: general
question: Planning Commission of India was set up in year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Planning Commission** was an institution in the** Government of India **formed in **1950. **
 
• Its primary function was the formulation of** India's Five-Year Plans. **
 
• The commission comprises the **Prime Minister **as the **ex officio Chairman** and a **Deputy Chairman,** with the rank of a full Cabinet Minister.
 
• **Cabinet Ministers** with certain important portfolios acted as **ex-officio members **of the Commission.
 
• The **full-time members** were **experts in various fields** like economics, industry, science, and general administration.
 
• The **Planning Commission** was** dissolved in 2014.**
 
• The** Government of India **constituted **NITI Aayog on 1 January 2015** to replace the **Planning Commission. **
